<description>
The shared multisig-creation helper (`src/rpc/util.cpp`, used by `createmultisig` and `addmultisigaddress`) rejects an `nrequired` below 1 and above the number of supplied keys:

- `nrequired < 1` → `"a multisignature address must require at least one key to redeem"`
- `nrequired > keys` → `"not enough keys supplied (got N keys, but need at least M to redeem)"`

The sibling ">20 keys" limit is already covered in `rpc_createmultisig.py`, but neither of these two bounds was exercised by any functional test. This adds assertions for both.

Ran `test/functional/rpc_createmultisig.py` locally — passes.
</description>
